$comment: Main extension point. Pages and widget manifests load in this order. Page titles may be a string or { en, it }. connection: engine = xerj (API token) or elasticsearch/opensearch (username and password); urlEditable: false fixes the URL; showUrl: false hides it (and fixes it); revealPassword: false removes the eye on password/token; demo: false hides the demo data; engineSelectable: true shows the XERJ flag in the login (engine = its default). See AGENTS.md.
